name: Meldina
title: Grand Master

villagemaster/32214.htm.text: Grand Master Meldina: Have you heard the news? Apparently all Giran is abuzz about our Kamael Guild; everyone, it seems, is on fire to know more about the Kamael, our abilities and our intentions. And interesting situation, to be sure. I could almost wish that another held this position...

links.text: Listen to information about second class transfer.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/32214-01.htm.text: Grand Master Meldina: Why have you come to me? Ah, the one you seek has already departed with the information. Why are you looking for him?

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/32214-03.htm.text: Meldina: The man you asked about said that he is on his way to the pier in Giran. Go there if you want to find him. Ask the wharf manager, Felton, about the freight itself.

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/32214-01.html.text: Grand Master Meldina: What is it? We are occupied with more urgent issues at the moment. Come again later...

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/32214-02.html.text: Grand Master Meldina: Hmm... I know who you are and why you have come. Truth be told, We have been watching you since you went to Master Rindy. In fact, we were preparing to contact you when you obtained the manuscript. And now you have come to me...

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/32214-05.html.text: Grand Master Meldina: Go find Celsia and take the test...

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/32214-06.html.text: Grand Master Meldina: How is the test progressing? Good luck, my young friend...

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/32214-02.htm.text: Grand Master Meldina: Nothing important. He just asked when the freight will arrive -- at the pier in Giran tomorrow, as it happens. Perhaps you will be able to find him there. Ask the wharf manager, Felton, about the freight itself if you are curious.

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/32214-03.html.text: Grand Master Meldina: I am a member of the secret society you have been investigating... We are called Inquisitors among those who know of our existence. It is our responsibility to protect the secrets of the Kamael, as well as to unearth conspiracies that might threaten our people. links.text: Yes, I want to take the test.

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/32214-04.html.text: Grand Master Meldina: Very well... Hand me the encrypted manuscript you have brought. I know the contents of the manuscript, but it is something not suited for you...yet. Do not be disappointed, however. You will have an opportunity to learn it later for yourself.
